name: Get meeting recording
description: Retrieves the cloud recording for a Microsoft Teams meeting using the join URL, meetingRecap URL, or conference ID. Returns the MP4 as a file when it is 100 MB or smaller. You must be the meeting owner (the organizer); attendees cannot download recordings. Recordings can take several minutes to appear after the meeting ends.

inputFields.label: Meeting join URL, recap URL, or conference ID
inputFields.description: The Teams meeting join URL, meetingRecap URL, or the conference ID (e.g. '398 774 104 902 21'). Use 'List meeting recordings' to find a recording's meeting. Join URL is used to look up the online meeting. Conference ID and recap URL look up calendar events in the past year and future 90 days as fallback.

inputFields.label: Occurrence date
inputFields.description: Return the recording for the meeting occurrence on this date (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '2025-01-15'). Use this instead of Offset when you know the date of the meeting occurrence. If no recording exists for the exact date, the closest available recording is returned with a notice.

inputFields.label: Offset
inputFields.description: Number of recordings to skip in the newest-first list. 0 is the latest recording, 1 is the second most recent, and so on. Defaults to 0.

inputFields.label: Limit
inputFields.description: Returns the most recent N recordings. Defaults to 1 if not specified. When Offset is 0 or unset, Occurrence date can narrow which recordings are selected.
